name: Nuoc mam Duy Trinh
summary: Nước mắm Duy Trinh is a fish sauce the Da Nang Fatherland Front lists at 4 stars. The sentence also names thị trấn Nam Phước. A 2021 line puts the Duy Trinh workshop at thôn An Lương, xã Duy Hải, as the maker of mắm ruốc. Both addresses stay.
origin: Duy Xuyên, on the Da Nang Fatherland Front’s OCOP account. Accessed 23 Oct 2026. The article’s own day was not in the text.
howToEat: The account does not say how to use the sauce. The method is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: The 4-star sentence ends with thị trấn Nam Phước, after nước mắm Duy Trinh, tơ lụa Mã Châu, and quạt gỗ Nguyễn Ngọc Hạnh.
The 2021 line places cơ sở sản xuất nước mắm Duy Trinh at thôn An Lương, xã Duy Hải. That line is about mắm ruốc. Both are printed. A shop door is Check on arrival.
